scripts.ts:clean: find . -type f -name "_companion_context.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "bridge.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "_constants.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "_helpers.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "_types.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "_main.js" -delete && npm run clean:ts --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.ts:compile: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run ts:compile --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.clean:deep: npm run ts:clean && npm run clean:deep --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.build: npm install && npm run build --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.build:dev: npm install && npm run build:dev --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.build:dev:clean: npm install && npm run build:dev:clean --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.test:wasm-runtime: npm run build --prefix wasm/ && npm run ts:compile:bridge && cd src-tauri && cargo test --locked bridge::plugins -- --include-ignored
scripts.test:bridge: npm run sdk:build && npm run ts:compile:bridge && node scripts/test-bridge.mjs
scripts.test:rust: npm run build --prefix wasm/ && npm run ts:compile:bridge && cd src-tauri && cargo test --locked -- --include-ignored
scripts.lint:rust: npm run ts:compile:bridge && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:runtime && npm run typecheck:sdk
